subject: Onboarding: PO instructions, DPA & SOC2 evidence handoff
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@onyxai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onyx AI onboarding packet + DPA/SOC2/subprocessor request

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Per our procurement checklist, I attached our completed onboarding form (OnyxAI_Onboarding_Form.pdf). To move forward with PO issuance and supplier activation, procurement asked for the following artifacts:

- Signed Data Processing Addendum (we can DocuSign if you prefer)
- A copy or link to your most recent SOC 2 report (or a secure viewer link)
- Current subprocessor list and any overseas subprocessors called out

Can you confirm the best path for each item and whether Redwood needs us to re-send anything to finance for net-30 PO processing? We would like to get the PO in place this week if possible — our internal go-live target is 9/5.

Attachments: OnyxAI_Onboarding_Form.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Soto
Vendor Ops Lead | Onyx AI
elena.soto@onyxai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@onyxai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onyx AI onboarding packet + DPA/SOC2/subprocessor request

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the form, and welcome! Quick answers / next steps from Redwood:

1) DPA: We have a standard DPA that we can send via DocuSign. If Onyx signs the standard form, procurement can proceed. If you have a negotiated redline, please upload it and mark as legal review — that will add a few business days.

2) SOC 2: We normally provide a secure viewer link for the latest SOC 2 Type II. I will share the secure link in a follow-up (we don't attach the full report over email).

3) Subprocessors: We publish an exported CSV of our subprocessor list; I'll include the current snapshot and highlight any non-US subprocessors.

4) PO process: Marcus in procurement will confirm the exact PO flow and the billing contact for invoice submission. Marcus — can you confirm whether finance requires a vendor record form + W-9 equivalent or if the onboarding form you received suffices? Also confirm PO numbering cadence so Onyx can reference on invoices.

Proposed timeline: DPA via DocuSign today; SOC2 link + subprocessor snapshot within 2 hours; procurement to confirm PO path by EOD. If that all lines up, PO ready by Friday (8/25) for target go-live 9/5.

If you want a brief screen share to walk through the portal and where to upload redlines, happy to schedule 20 minutes.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@onyxai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: PO instructions and vendor activation checklist

Hi Elena / Grace —

Following up on Grace's note. For Redwood procurement to issue PO_2028-1347 we need the following:

1) Signed DPA (DocuSign link acceptable) OR a signed PDF emailed to procurement@redwood.com.
2) Completed vendor banking & tax form (we accept W-9 for US vendors or the local equivalent). If the onboarding form doesn't include full banking info, please complete PO_template.xlsx and return.
3) Billing contact (name + billing email) and whether invoices will be sent to AP@onyxai.com or billed through a 3rd-party AR system.

Once we have those, we'll route the PO for internal approvals. I have attached a blank PO_template.xlsx for bank & tax fields. I can also provision a temporary vendor record in our ERP so you can email invoices once PO is live.

Attachments: PO_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 tabs)

If Onyx is comfortable, we will create the PO in the system and send the official PO PDF — you can confirm upon receipt and proceed to invoice.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@onyxai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@onyxai.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO instructions and vendor activation checklist

Thanks Marcus — attaching our signed DPA and completed PO_template.xlsx.

Notes:
- DPA has been signed by our legal team and is attached as OnyxAI_DPA_signed.pdf. If you prefer DocuSign verification, here's the envelope link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/abc123-onx-dpa
- SOC 2: public viewer link below (expires in 7 days): https://docs.onyxai.com/SOC2/report-onyx-soc2-2028.pdf
- Subprocessors: included in the body of this email and as a 1-page CSV in the onboarding packet. Key overseas subprocessors: EdgeCloud Ltd (UK), DataSync PH (Philippines) — both used for logging and backup.

Billing contact: AP team <ap@onyxai.com> (invoices@onyxai.com), remit-to details are in the PO_template.xlsx tab "Banking".

We received a placeholder PO number from your team earlier (PO_2028-1347) — please confirm when the signed PO PDF is generated so we can route invoices against that PO.

Attachments: OnyxAI_DPA_signed.pdf; PO_template.xlsx (completed)

Onyx AI — Subprocessor list (summary):
- EdgeCloud Ltd — logging & metrics — UK
- DataSync PH — backups & archival — Philippines
- TranslatePro Inc. — optional ML translation — US

If you need anything else to finish approvals, ping me. We can also accept e-invoicing to AP@onyxai.com if that shortens the cycle.

Best,
Elena Soto
Vendor Ops Lead | Onyx AI
elena.soto@onyxai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
